commands.name: search-news
commands.summary: Keyword search across ABC News content (articles, video, audio) via the site's Algolia index

commands.name: get-top-stories
commands.summary: Homepage top stories for the national edition or a state edition

commands.name: list-topic-stories
commands.summary: Paginated JSON list of stories for a topic, by the topic's internal documentId (e.g. 1450 = Climate Change)

commands.name: list-topic-page
commands.summary: Latest stories on a topic page by topic slug (first page, server-rendered)

commands.name: list-section-stories
commands.summary: Story headlines from a news section page, e.g. justin (latest news), politics, world, business

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Article metadata (headline, description, dates, authors, keywords) from an article URL's date, slug and id

commands.name: list-author-stories
commands.summary: Latest stories by an ABC reporter, from their profile page

commands.name: list-topics
commands.summary: A-Z topics library: topics starting with a letter (links to /news/topic/{slug})

commands.name: list-location-topics
commands.summary: A-Z location topics (places) starting with a letter
